title: O2 triplet, ROHF/6-31G, windowed with frozen virtuals
description: The first entry whose window closes below the last orbital, so it exercises frozen virtuals as well as frozen core. Two frozen core orbitals rather than one.

active_space.notes: Both O 1s frozen below the window and six virtuals frozen above it. The full-space oracle must apply the same double truncation.

solver.notes: Small enough for exact diagonalisation, so this entry doubles as the truth source for the solver adapters.

provenance.geometry_source: Idealised diatomic at the near-equilibrium bond length; not optimised at this level of theory.
